answer: Each agent must stake a bond and complete a unique proof-of-voyage: a signed, time-locked route across the network's grove of validator nodes, with every hop attested by a distinct peer. Forging N identities means funding N bonds, sustaining N routes, and colluding with N disjoint validators, so cost scales linearly while honest peers on any island of the network can reject the batch.
